title: Modi government will see the result in six months- Mamata Bnerjee | Mamata's big announcement about central government.
description: Everyone's eyes are on the Delhi tour of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. Yesterday, Mamta Banerjee held a meeting with the leaders of the opposition and then also met the PM. And today Mamta arrived to meet Sonia Gandhi. In the evening, he also met Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal. Mamta's purpose is to form a alliance against the BJP across the country.
